premises.note: Factories, generic initialization under its entry premise, and fresh-factory composition all pass selected proofs. The actual unsafe static C wrapper is a different execution path and remains unverified.
Every dispatch proof requires outgoing ghost event slots empty at entry; current wrapper/runtime correspondence and its preservation across actual dispatches are not proved.

The trusted external input bridge promises the input/ghost relation and non-Critical classification. One Logika implication connects the Gate guarantee to this assumption under connection-value equality. It does not prove physical transport equality, no loss or eventual delivery.
Generated external_body input/output methods connect ghost port state to unsafe C APIs; their physical correspondence is outside these component proofs.

ledger_links: exact cited source passage and source hash
generic_coverage_behavior.missing_or_mismatched_link_behavior: Missing ledger yields NOT_RUN. Unresolved element or ownership yields FAIL mapping. Missing or mismatched formal-unit evidence is rejected by the verification predicate.

fingerprint_and_review_behavior.input_scope: Explicitly declared input-file bytes, including permitted dirty/untracked contents; no claim of a hash of the entire filesystem.
bound_contents: reviewed scope, current evidence, exclusions and blockers
approval subject digest or review fingerprint
fingerprint_and_review_behavior.stale_inputs: Changed declared source bytes or policy approval invalidates evidence_current_for_source/policy_current; fresh review or checking is required.
fingerprint_and_review_behavior.tampered_objects: A mismatched object hash/path is rejected when loaded.
fingerprint_and_review_behavior.exclusions: Require a classification, reason, revisit condition and approval tied to the evidence fingerprint. Original observed results remain retained.
fingerprint_and_review_behavior.acceptance: All included mandatory evidence must be current and passing; current approval must match the resulting fingerprint. Exclusion approval and acceptance approval are separate.
fingerprint_and_review_behavior.human_review_scope: Requirement interpretation, non-behavioral requirements, assumptions and exclusions require explicit review. Technical claims still require the applicable analysis/proof/test/observation.
fingerprint_and_review_behavior.attribution_limit: Reviewer identifiers attribute local decisions; they do not authenticate a person.

design_and_role_boundary.early_semantic_prediction_admission: Design-level extension; no implemented forecast-driven semantic admission rule established by these sources.
design_and_role_boundary.generalize_and_specialize: Implemented workflow strategies using the same ModelWorker.
design_and_role_boundary.forecast_interpretation: Model-reported belief; no calibrated success probability or acceptance authority.

limits: This extract follows one relation from the separate SNG audit and does not claim generic-ledger coverage for every case.
The recorded 201-file audit is prior evidence; this extraction rechecked only the selected source files listed above.
The saved component proof receipts include dependency counts; these are kept distinct from target-crate units and requirement counts.
Full-system occurrence correspondence, external-interface correspondence and timing guarantees remain unresolved in the selected evidence.
Original source files, complete proof dependencies and the full execution archive are not bundled by this extract.
